body.input: Which robotics companies opened an office in Sweden in 2026?

response.content:
I wasn't able to find specific reports of robotics companies that opened a new office in Sweden during 2026. The available sources list robotics companies already based in Sweden (such as Cognibotics, Dyno Robotics, Tendo Technology, Northsence, Gleechi Technology, and others) but do not highlight particular office-opening announcements by outside robotics firms expanding into Sweden this year.

If you're tracking inbound investment, Business Sweden's "Invest in Sweden" service and directories like BounceWatch or The Robotics Media may have more granular, up-to-date records of new market entries.

explainability.content: The provided fact list of top robotics companies in Sweden (Fact ID ded9771d-8a80-4f40-b5d5-2d68a3f6cf18) only enumerates companies already operating in Sweden and contains no mention of any new office openings in 2026.

The Business Sweden "Invest in Sweden" description (Fact ID d8a7d0c2-0e61-41f8-968b-9ab95c014412) outlines services for expansion but does not cite any specific robotics firms that opened offices in Sweden in 2026.

Because the available sources contain only existing company listings and generic investment service information, there are no concrete reports of robotics companies opening new offices in Sweden during 2026, leading to the answer that no specific office-opening announcements were found.
